name: liketypeless
description: Local-first Windows voice input, text structuring, and translation assistant.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,desktop -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:desktop"
scripts.dev:desktop: npm --workspace @liketypeless/shared run build && npm --workspace apps/desktop run dev
scripts.check: npm --workspace @liketypeless/shared run check && npm --workspace @liketypeless/desktop run check
scripts.check:api: cd apps/local-api && python -m compileall app scripts
